author: ojiudezue
title: HVAC precedence: URA energy actions (nudges, borrow starts) win over person protection; person protection survives restarts
summary: W1-B rulings: nudges win over a human change during the nudge (D13); borrow starts (pre-cool, pre-heat, pre-arrival, nudge, compromise) proceed even when a zone is person-protected (D48); the vacancy-away shortcut keeps today's behaviour (D49). Person protection itself (immune holds D17, TAO restored if still inside its 6 h window D46) now persists across restarts and reloads; an immune person still wins over an arrester compromise (D50). Small human changes the arrester ignores are reclaimed and logged, no alert (D18).
why: Operator: "URA has more information and should win. URA understands energy saving strategies and Operators don't. They can redo if they want to pre-empt automation changes that are valid." Nudges measured 97% effective, and the operator had interrupted one with less information than its intent. But once S1 reclaims manual holds, a restart that forgets a protection would silently undo a person's hold — the old manual guard used to hide that — so protection had to become durable.
alternatives_considered: Gate borrow starts on person protection (reviewer D-H2) — rejected by operator
Keep TAO default-OFF on restart (F7 restart amnesty) — superseded: OFF is no longer 'safe' when S1 reclaims
Accept losing immune holds on restart — rejected; restart storms are live (~8/night)
implications: The core invariant is scoped: protections stop S1 reclaim and the arrester, NOT URA energy actions. Any future 'person override' feature must state where it sits in this order: nudge_win > immune stamp > compromise; borrow starts ignore person protection; hard reset respects only person protection (D52, by analogy). Persistence rides _zone_state_store side-keys (__immune_holds, __tao_state), not a DB table.
revisit_trigger: Operator complaints that URA energy actions undo deliberate comfort choices; nudge effectiveness < 80% over 7 d (the nudge-wins revival trigger).
